summary.en: An internally developed pipeline is expanding from oncology into metabolic, cardiovascular and immune diseases, with multiple China filings accepted in 2026. Overseas out-licensing contributes collaboration revenue and global development capacity.
summary.zh: 自研管线正从肿瘤拓展至代谢、心血管和免疫疾病,2026年多项中国申报获受理。海外对外授权带来合作收入和全球开发能力。

ind.en: Adult long-term weight management; also type 2 diabetes (both filed in China)
ind.zh: 成人长期体重管理;另有2型糖尿病(均已在中国申报)
成人2型糖尿病(中国申报)

ind.en: Adult moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis; also Phase 3 prurigo nodularis, adolescent AD and seasonal allergic rhinitis
ind.zh: 成人中重度特应性皮炎;另有结节性痒疹、青少年AD和季节性过敏性鼻炎III期

ind.en: New indication: unresectable/metastatic HER2-low breast cancer after zero or one metastatic chemotherapy line (China filing)
ind.zh: 新适应症:既往未接受或仅接受过一线转移性化疗的不可切除/转移性HER2低表达乳腺癌(中国申报)

ind.en: Obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (China Phase 3); also non-obstructive HCM Phase 2
ind.zh: 梗阻性肥厚型心肌病(中国III期);另有非梗阻性HCM II期

next.en: Partner plans Phase 2b TRUEHEART-HCM in obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
next.zh: 合作伙伴计划开展梗阻性肥厚型心肌病IIb期TRUEHEART-HCM

watch.en: China accepted HRS-7535 diabetes and weight-management filings and ribupatide’s diabetes filing in Q3 2026; decision dates were not disclosed.
watch.zh: 2026年第三季度,中国受理了HRS-7535糖尿病和体重管理申报以及ribupatide糖尿病申报;决定日期未披露。

watch.en: The HRS-1596 Novo Nordisk license has a $300 million upfront payment and up to $2.6 billion total potential value; closing is expected in Q4 2026.
watch.zh: HRS-1596对Novo Nordisk的授权包含3亿美元首付款,潜在总价值最高26亿美元;预计2026年第四季度完成交割。

watch.en: Non-oncology drugs were 28.88% of innovative-drug sales in the first nine months of 2026; oncology remains the larger component.
watch.zh: 2026年前九个月,非肿瘤药物占创新药销售额的28.88%;肿瘤仍是占比更大的部分。

watch.en: H1 2026 R&D investment was RMB4.61 billion, or 29.8% of revenue.
watch.zh: 2026年上半年研发投入为46.1亿元人民币,占收入的29.8%。

sources: HRS9531 peptide modality and internal origin, May 17, 2024 filing
HRS-1893 internal discovery and Braveheart license, September 5, 2025
gaps: Reported phase-advancement figures are not total pipeline inventory; counts remains null.
No dated next milestones were verified for the selected assets. The planned partner TRUEHEART-HCM Phase 2b study has no stated start date in the November update.
Ribupatide peptide modality uses a May 2024 company filing; HRS-1893 internal provenance uses a September 2025 company release. Both predate June 2026; current stages use 2026 releases.
An English generic name for SHR-1819 was not verified. Stages refer to China; overseas partner development may differ.
A subsequent decision on the July 2026 trastuzumab rezetecan HER2-low breast-cancer filing was not verified.
